originalBody:
Nguyễn Khánh Huyền

Tester Team Leader

Tester Team Leader with 7 years of experience in software testing and holding advanced international QA certifications. Strong leadership skills and extensive experience in training and developing testing teams. Seeking opportunities to take on a management role in a professional testing environment where I can contribute to technological advancement and product quality enhancement.

Work experience

08/2022

-

08/2025

Tester Leader

Minwon Vietnam Technology JSC

  • Responsible for managing the team's testing tasks and activities.
  • Collaborated with the team on project requirements to develop test plans and strategies, managing progress and quality.
  • Performed testing on various product types using different test techniques and tools to ensure customer requirements were met.
  • Reviewed test documents, conducted functional and performance testing.
  • Ensured timely delivery and quality, and reported regularly to management.
  • Participated in documentation creation and user guide development.
  • Evaluated, trained, and supported team members to build a competent QA team.
  • Compiled project issues and proposed improvement solutions.
  • Consolidated team testing results and created quality analysis reports for clients.
  • Monitored, controlled, and evaluated project risks.

08/2018

-

07/2022

Tester Leader

YJH & Partners

  • Received testing requests for IT products and services.
  • Researched, analyzed, clarified requirements, and created test strategies.
  • Developed testing strategies/plans for banking IT products/systems; wrote scripts, created test reports, bug reports, and related documentation.
  • Coordinated, trained, and managed the team.
  • Conducted testing and quality evaluation of products.
  • Analyzed and evaluated post-go-live defects.
Activities
